evals.prompt: I want to build a notification system for my app. Users should get notified when stuff happens — like someone comments on their post, or they get a new follower. I also want email digests. Can you help me think through this?
evals.expected_output: A feature spec that covers the notification data model (notification types, read/unread state, delivery channels), discusses push vs pull, considers batching/digesting, and surfaces edge cases like notification preferences and muting. Should NOT jump to implementation details like specific push notification services.

evals.prompt: We finished our MVP (milestone 1) which lets users create and manage recipes. Now I want to plan milestone 2 — we want to add meal planning and grocery lists. A user should be able to plan meals for the week and auto-generate a shopping list from the ingredients. What should the spec look like?
evals.expected_output: A spec that identifies cross-milestone impacts (recipe data model changes needed to support ingredient extraction), defines the meal plan and grocery list data models, handles edge cases (duplicate ingredients across recipes, unit conversion), and keeps UI scope directional. Should reference M1's recipe model and call out what needs to change.

evals.prompt: I have an idea for a feature but it's kind of vague. Basically I want users of my fitness app to be able to challenge each other. Like, I challenge you to run 50 miles this month. And there's some kind of leaderboard or progress tracking. Help me flesh this out?
evals.expected_output: The agent should help sharpen the vague idea through questions (1v1 vs group challenges? fixed or custom goals? what metrics are trackable?), then gradually build toward a spec. Should surface design decisions like challenge lifecycle (pending/active/complete), what happens when someone declines, how progress syncs with workout data. Should NOT produce a fully rigid spec immediately — should show the iterative conversation-to-structure arc.
